fusions.name: Startle Kick
fusions.desc: An iron-shod kick in every direction that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocks them back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Locked Tines
fusions.desc: A lunge that deals 7 damage, up to 1.2 times as much at 2.5 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges; a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Flinch Guard
fusions.desc: Raises a quick barrier that absorbs the next 12 damage, up to 3 blows, for 4 seconds and raises your armour by 6%, and you move 30% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Bounding Ward
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you gain a shield worth 8% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
